preregistered_plan.goal: Exactly reconstruct the ORIGINAL physical point q0 250ms signed 40/80Hz wave transfer of native PPW40 and44 entire 3D exact-roof FV/Newmark from a COMPLETE x⊗yz generalized Neumann eigenbasis; quantify high modal tail's signed grid-to-grid difference without changing numerical model or source.

pinned.temporal_source: q[0]=1 and q[n>0]=0 on original Ts and Nt

numerical.yz_solver: scipy.linalg.eigh full symmetric normalized mass-inverted Kyz dense; no eigenvalue truncation
numerical.analytical_250ms_NT_Fourier: for each Newmark eigenvalue lambda with theta=2atan(dt*sqrt(lambda)/2), u[n]=dt²c²source-receiver-coupling/(1+dt²lambda/4)*sin(n theta)/sin theta, pressure original rho*2nd-order endpoint/interior derivative; calculate full finite-record sum analytically by geometric sine/cosine progression, including exact q0 source denominator, no taper or smoothing
numerical.finite_window_formula: H= rho*amp/dt*(2-cos(theta) + 0.5*(G(N-2,omega*dt+theta)+G(N-2,omega*dt-theta)) + exp(i*omega*(N-1)*dt)*(R(N-1,theta)+(cos(theta)-2)*R(N-2,theta))), R(m,t)=sin(m*t)/sin(t), G(m,b)=m exp(i*(m+1)*b/2)*sinc(m*b/(2pi))/sinc(b/(2pi)); all modes summed signed

decomposition.band_boundaries: [lo,hi) except last to infinity; ALL modes exactly one band
